title: Quiet test output and npm notices
goal: npm test prints dots, failures and totals; the full report goes to an ignored file
acceptance: Dots, every failure in full and the totals on screen; complete spec report in an ignored file
A test proves a failing test and a test's log are not lost
.npmrc loglevel=warn; characters before and after recorded
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Quieting an output must never hide a failure

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
